action.text: The cooler's condition changed to Degraded (degraded since cycle 733, 99% failure probability). According to the 'Why this prediction' (top SHAP drivers) panel, the main reason is a drop in Cooling efficiency (CE_mean) to 28.08%, followed by elevated Pressure 2 (PS2_mean, 106 bar) and Pressure 1 (PS1_mean, 156.7 bar). The maintenance team should check the cooling system first — the cooler's heat-exchange/cooling performance (low cooling efficiency, low cooling power of 2.15 kW) — and inspect for blockages/fouling, coolant flow, and the cooler itself. They should also verify the related temperature sensors (TS1 53.4°C, TS2 58.63°C, TS3 55.97°C, TS4 47.24°C) and the pressure sensors (PS1, PS2) to rule out sensor faults versus a genuine pressure/cooling problem. A work order (WO-0001) is already open for this component.
